title: Phase Transitions with Lyapunov Exponents under Einstein and String Frames in Dilatonic Reissner--Nordström--AdS Black Holes
summary: We investigate Lyapunov exponents as dynamical probes of black hole phase transitions in dilatonic Reissner--Nordström--AdS black holes within Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton theory. The thermodynamic quantities and the Lyapunov exponent of charged probe particles were analyzed in both the Einstein and string frames, thus providing a direct comparison between the thermodynamic phase structure of the black hole and that captured by the Lyapunov exponent.
